items.update: The yellow base background makes text hard to read, especially while typing. We'd suggest a white base, with yellow only as an accent if needed.
Vaibhav, was there a specific reason for the yellow (e.g. contrast), because the this makes a shift in all the screens?
On the main login screen, we need to have UI which can support email+password or the mobile otp flow, but new UI looks confusing.
Show large point balances in short form (e.g. 11,965 → 11.9K) so the layout doesn't break as balances grow.
"X points away from next tier" isn't visible. Please also add text for users already on the top tier (Platinum).
The card and border style feels dated and heavy. Please simplify it to reduce information overload.
Overall existing built screen looks better.
The Dine-in / Takeaway choice should be the first thing on the screen, and should carry through the whole order.
Detail screen for each item is fine, just that it should be bottom drawer.
Promo codes: instead of a text box with an Apply button, list the available coupons, each with its own Apply button. Grey out coupons that don't apply to the current order.
Free-item coupons: applying the coupon unlocks the free item, and the user then adds it to the cart.
Joy Points: uses a slider instead of a text box, which also avoids invalid entries. The slider's maximum is the amount left to pay after discounts, not the full points balance.
Gift card → Money Wallet: show Joy Points and the Money Wallet as separate sections.
Keep discounts and payment separate: coupons and promo codes reduce the order total first (e.g. 27 → 20). Points, wallet and card then pay the rest, and combining them should be supported.
Points cover the full amount: if points cover the whole order, place the order directly and skip the payment step.
We'd like Apple Pay and Samsung Pay integrated natively in the app, not only through the payment gateway's page. We need to check feasibility and effort.

Token number: show the store's token number first, as soon as the order is placed, linked to the order ID. Keep it visible afterwards (e.g. a small banner) so the customer knows which number to collect.

Status tracker: a multi-step tracker (Placed → Preparing → Ready → Delivered) isn't needed for now, since QSR orders are ready in about 5–7 minutes. We can add it later if Aloha can send status updates.
Points earned: points aren't credited instantly. Show a message such as "Points will be credited after a certain period."
The new layout (subtotal, discounts, total, status) works well and needs only minor refinements.
Keep the "Need help with this order?" option, with call/contact.
The flow is mostly fine. Please add templates (e.g. Birthday, Congratulations) and transaction history.
We need to remove the old flow of card number + pin, as now the gift card with entitled to user's id directly.
